Washington, DC, July 18, 2026 – A new Washington Post/Ipsos poll finds that economic concerns are poised to play a large role in the 2026 midterm elections, with Americans remaining pessimistic about the trajectory of the economy and future economic prospects for people like them.

This economic pessimism also extends to views on gas prices, with 59% saying they are not confident that negotiations to end the U.S.-Iran war will bring gas prices down to normal. [...] Washington, D.C., April 28, 2026 – This latest Reuters/Ipsos poll, conducted April 24-27, finds that a rising share of Americans say the national economy is off on the wrong track: 61%, up from 43% in January 2025.
